changes: Disk Analyzer now lets you select/deselect files before deleting, just like Large Files and Duplicates — nothing is removed without you picking it first.
New app icon and title bar mark.

Quick Clean, Claude Cleanup, Disk Analyzer, Large Files, and Duplicates now keep scanning or deleting in the background if you switch to another page, instead of stopping — a toast in the top-right lets you know when a job finishes while you're away.
The version number in Settings now always matches the running app version.
Fixed dropdown menus (like the drive picker) rendering unreadable white-on-white text.
Added a drive picker to Disk Analyzer, Large Files, and Duplicates so you can jump straight to any drive, not just C:\Users.
Added automatic updates — Aurum Cleaner now checks for new versions on launch, downloads them in the background, and installs on restart.
Added this What's New screen, shown once after every update.
Initial release: Dashboard, Quick Clean, Disk Analyzer, Large Files, Duplicates, and Claude Cleanup.
